(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, a. the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring a portion of the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity and not directly before the first quantity.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without substantial protrusions extending therefrom.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially flat and smooth.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by more than one method including passing the finger through the ring portion.
